Spiritual Leader: Once per battle, at the start of your Command Phase, you can select 1 friendly Genestealer Cults unit that is within 12" and visible to this unit and select 1 of the following abilities to occur:

  • If the unit is Battle Shocked, the unit is no longer Battle Shocked.

A Special Concoction: Once per Battle Round, during your Command Phase, you can choose to use this ability. To do so, select 1 Genestealer Cults Infantry unit with at least 1 model within 3" of this model and roll a D6. On a 3+, select 1 of the following abilities to be in effect for models in that unit until the end of the Battle Round:

  • Melee attacks score Critical Hits on a 4+, but gain the Hazardous D3 ability
  • Melee attacks score Critical Wounds on a 4+, but gain the Hazardous D3 ability
  • Gain the Fearless ability
  • Gain the Relentless ability
  • Increase Toughness characteristic by 1 and gain the Feel No Pain 4+ ability, but models in the unit reduce their Wounds characteristic by 1 (to a minimum of 1)
  • Increase Weapons Skill, Ballistic Skill, Initiative and Attacks characteristics by 1

On a roll of a 1, that unit suffers D6+3 Mortal Wounds, but all abilities above are considered to be in effect for that unit until the end of the Battle.

sections.label: Ridgehauler Trailers
sections.prose:
Each Ridgehauler Trailer in this unit must start the battle being Towed. The first Ridgehauler Trailer added to the unit must always be physically connected to the Ridgehauler (or Ironcrawler) model towing it by a trailer hitch, and second Ridgehauler Trailer must be connected to the first Ridgehauler Trailer via a similar trailer hitch.

Each Ridgehauler Trailer model's characteristics are separate from the model towing it and can always be targeted separately from the Ridgehauler (or Ironcrawler) as if it was its own unit.

When the Ridgehauler (or Ironcrawler) model is itself destroyed, any Ridgehauler Trailers being towed by that model can only use the Shoot Action in subsequent Activations. Should the first Ridgehauler Trailer be destroyed before the second, the second then becomes Detached from the Ridgehauler (or Ironcrawler) model that was previously Towing it, and counts as a separate unit. However, a player can choose to re-connect the remaining Ridgehauler Trailer by completing a Move Action with the Ridgehauler (or Ironcrawler) that ends with the rear quadrant of the model within 1" of the Ridgehauler Trailer. At the start of the next Battle Round, the Ridgehauler Trailer is considered to be Towed again, and the units are considered 1 unit once more.
